comment: LOKA Atlas capability catalog — single source of truth for the wizard (display), the API (validation, cost gate) and the Python builder (recipe dispatch). tiers: which region tiers can use a layer ('global' = any country, 'india' = ISO3 IND). cost: 'free' builds run immediately; 'approval' needs an admin OK (large source downloads). Layer stanzas themselves live in the recipes, ported from the proven deoria-bioregion manifest styling.

tiers.global: Baseline — open worldwide sources (geoBoundaries, OSM, ESA WorldCover)
tiers.india: Enhanced — adds LGD boundaries and WRIS/NDEM water & flood layers
